$comment: VALE team buffs (CONTRACT §5.4 camps/objectives/structures; WORLD glossary). A unit's onTakedownTeamBuff grants one of these to every fighter of the killing team (stats + passives) and to its Wicks (minionStats). Granting an id the team already holds refreshes its duration (sim core.ts addTeamBuff). Splinters is designed to stack to 3; the sim currently refreshes instead (SIM/LEAD request: _design/sections/modes_economy.md §10).

teamBuffs.name: Clearglass
teamBuffs.desc: From the Glasshorn, for 90 s: your whole team gains +10 ability haste and +1.5 resource regeneration per second.

teamBuffs.name: Resinburn
teamBuffs.desc: From the Resinback, for 90 s: your team's basic attacks on fighters and monsters burn for 3 magic hits over 2 s and slow briefly. Once every 3 s per target.

passives.name: Resinburn
passives.desc: Basic attacks on fighters and monsters burn for 3 hits of 4 + 2 per level magic damage over 2 s and slow by 10% for 1 s. Once every 3 s per target.

teamBuffs.name: Splinters
teamBuffs.desc: From the Sunsplinter, for 4:00: your team gains +5% armor and resist penetration and +5 ability haste. The next Sunsplinter you take renews it.

teamBuffs.name: The Long Shade
teamBuffs.desc: From Longshade, for 2:30: your team gains +25 attack, +40 power and +10% tenacity. Your Wicks march tougher, harder-hitting and faster.

teamBuffs.name: Lanternwake
teamBuffs.desc: You broke an enemy Lantern. For 4:00 your Wicks on every road gain +120 health, +10 attack and +10 armor and resist.
